name: starter-p2-intermodal-local-nights
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-intermodal-local-nights brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering
